description: Wait until a named DOM event (e.g. "transitionend", "load", a custom event) fires on the element identified by ref or selector — or on document when neither is given. Returns: { ok, session_id, fired, event }. Errors: WAIT_TIMEOUT (event did not fire within timeoutMs; retryable), SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (target element not present), REF_NOT_FOUND (stale ref; carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid selector, or ref+selector both).

eventName.description: DOM event name to wait for, e.g. "transitionend".

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Max wait in ms (default 5000, clamped to 60000).

name: electron_wait_for_event
title: Wait for a DOM event
